059        public static class BarAmbiencePlayer implements EveryFrameScript {
060                public MarketAPI market;
061                public String soundId = "bar_ambience";
062                public float pitch = 1f;
063                public float volume = 1f;
064                public float musicSuppression = 0.95f;
065                public boolean done = false;
066                
067                public FaderUtil fader = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.5f);
068                public BarAmbiencePlayer(MarketAPI market) {
069                        this.market = market;
070                        if (market.getFaction() != null) {
071                                soundId = market.getFaction().getBarSound();
072                        }
073                        fader.fadeIn();
074                }
075                public void advance(float amount) {
076                        fader.advance(amount);
077                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().suppressMusic(fader.getBrightness() * musicSuppression);
078                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUILoop(soundId, pitch, volume * fader.getBrightness());
079                        if (!Global.getSector().isPaused()) {
080                                stop();
081                        }
082                }
083                public boolean isDone() {
084                        return done;
085                }
086                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
087                        return true;
088                }
089                public void stop() {
090                        done = true;
091                }
092        }
093        
094        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
095                this.dialog = dialog;
096                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
097                if (dialog == null) return false;
098
099                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
100                if (command == null) return false;
101                
102                
103                if (command.equals("returnFromEvent")) {
104                        MemoryAPI mem = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
105                        BarCMD cmd = (BarCMD) mem.get("$BarCMD");
106                        if (cmd == null) return false;
107                        mem.unset("$BarCMD");
108                        //mem.unset("$currMission_ref");
109                        
110                        dialog.setPlugin(cmd);
111                        abortMissions(null);
112
113                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(null);
114                        ((RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl)cmd.originalPlugin).updateMemory();
115//                      memoryMap.put(MemKeys.LOCAL, dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemoryWithoutUpdate());
116//                      memoryMap.remove(MemKeys.ENTITY);
117
118                        
119                        boolean withContinue = params.size() > 1 && params.get(1).getBoolean(memoryMap);
120                        cmd.returningFromEvent(withContinue);
121                        
122                        return true;
123                } else if (command.equals("accept")) {
124                        //MemoryAPI mem = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
125                        //Object ref = mem.get("$currMission_ref");
126                        
127                        String missionId = params.get(1).getString(memoryMap);
128                        HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = getWrapperFor(missionId);
129                        if (w != null && w.getMission() != null) {
130                                BarEventManager.getInstance().notifyWasInteractedWith(w);
131                                w.getMission().accept(dialog, memoryMap);
132                        }
133                        return true;
134                } else if (command.equals("leaveBar")) {
135                        leaveBar();
136                        return true;
137                } else if (command.equals("playAmbience")) {
138                        entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
139                        if (!Global.getSector().hasTransientScript(BarAmbiencePlayer.class)) {
140                                Global.getSector().addTransientScript(new BarAmbiencePlayer(entity.getMarket()));
141                        }
142                        return true;
143                }
144                
145//              else if (command.equals("addContact")) {
146//                      ContactIntel.addPotentialContact(contact, text)
147//              }
148                
149                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
150                originalPlugin = dialog.getPlugin();
151                
152                //FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "SalvageSpecialFinishedNoContinue");
153                
154                if (command.equals("showOptions")) {
155                        showOptions(false);
156                        if (!Global.getSector().hasTransientScript(BarAmbiencePlayer.class)) {
157                                Global.getSector().addTransientScript(new BarAmbiencePlayer(entity.getMarket()));
158                        }
159                }
160                
161                return true;
162        }
163        
164        public void showOptions(boolean returningFromEvent) {
165                dialog.getVisualPanel().restoreSavedVisual();
166                dialog.getVisualPanel().saveCurrentVisual();
167                
168                PortsideBarData data = PortsideBarData.getInstance();
169                
170                MarketAPI market = entity.getMarket();
171                
172                dialog.getOptionPanel().clearOptions();
173                
174                Random random = new Random(BarEventManager.getInstance().getSeed(entity, null, null));
175                
176                int min = Global.getSettings().getInt("minBarEvents");
177                int max = Global.getSettings().getInt("maxBarEvents");
178                float pMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("barEventProbOneMore");
179                //int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
180                
181                WeightedRandomPicker<Integer> numPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Integer>(random);
182                float p = 1f;
183                for (int i = min; i <= max; i++) {
184                        numPicker.add(i, p);
185                        p *= pMult;
186                }
187                int num = numPicker.pick();
188                
189                if (DebugFlags.BAR_DEBUG) {
190                        max = 8;
191                        num = 7;
192                        //num = max;
193                }
194                
195                //num = 1000;
196                
197                List<PortsideBarEvent> events = new ArrayList<PortsideBarEvent>();
198                String key = "$BarCMD_shownEvents";
199                MemoryAPI mem = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
200                boolean needToSaveShown = false;
201                if (mem.contains(key)) {
202                        List<String> eventIds = (List<String>) mem.get(key);
203                        for (String id : eventIds) {
204                                OUTER: for (PortsideBarEvent event : data.getEvents()) {
205//                                      for (GenericBarEventCreator c : BarEventManager.getInstance().getTimeout().getItems()) {
206//                                              if (c.getBarEventId() != null && c.getBarEventId().equals(id)) {
207//                                                      continue OUTER;
208//                                              }
209//                                      }
210                                        if (id.equals(event.getBarEventId())) {
211                                                events.add(event);
212                                        }
213                                }
214                        }
215                        num = Math.max(eventIds.size(), num);
216                } else {
217                        events.addAll(data.getEvents());
218                        Collections.shuffle(events, random);
219                        needToSaveShown = true;
220                }
221                
222                boolean addedSomething = false;
223                
224                AddBarEvent.clearTempEvents(market);
225                FireAll.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "AddBarEvents");
226                
227                List<BarEventData> temp = new ArrayList<BarEventData>(AddBarEvent.getTempEvents(market).events.values());
228                for (int i = 0; i < max && i < temp.size(); i++) {
229                        BarEventData b = temp.get(i);
230                        if (!b.blurb.isEmpty()) {
231                                dialog.getTextPanel().addPara(b.blurb);
232                        }
233                        dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption(b.option, b.optionId);
234                        if (b.optionColor != null) {
235                                dialog.setOptionColor(b.optionId, b.optionColor);
236                        }
237                        addedSomething = true;
238                }
239                
240                List<String> shown = new ArrayList<String>();
241                
242                // used alongside with ip.excludeFromGetPerson() to ensure that the same person isn't picked
243                // for multiple concurrent bar events
244                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
245                ip.resetExcludeFromGetPerson();
246                
247                // existing contacts don't show up at the bar, since the bar encounter dialogue is written
248                // assuming you're meeting them for the first time
249                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
250                        ip.excludeFromGetPerson(((ContactIntel)intel).getPerson());
251                }
252                
253//              BaseMissionHub.resetMissionAngle(null, market);
254//              BaseMissionHub.getMissionAngle(null, market, random);
255                
256                Collections.sort(events, new Comparator<PortsideBarEvent>() {
257                        public int compare(PortsideBarEvent o1, PortsideBarEvent o2) {
258                                boolean p1 = o1.isAlwaysShow();
259                                boolean p2 = o2.isAlwaysShow();
260                                if (p1 && !p2) return -1;
261                                if (p2 && !p1) return 1;
262                                return 0;
263                        }
264                });
265                
266                int curr = 0;
267                //for (PortsideBarEvent event : data.getEvents()) {
268                for (PortsideBarEvent event : events) {
269                        if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) continue;
270                        if (curr + temp.size() >= max) break;
271                        
272//                      if (curr < 16) {
273//                              curr++;
274//                              continue;
275//                      }
276                        
277                        if (event.shouldRemoveEvent()) continue;
278                        if (!event.shouldShowAtMarket(market)) continue;
279                        
280                        event.addPromptAndOption(dialog, memoryMap);
281                        if (event instanceof HubMissionBarEventWrapper) {
282                                HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = (HubMissionBarEventWrapper) event;
283                                if (w.getMission() == null) { // aborted during creation
284                                        continue;
285                                }
286                        }
287                        event.wasShownAtMarket(market);
288                        
289                        if (event.getBarEventId() != null) {
290                                shown.add(event.getBarEventId());
291                        }
292                        
293                        addedSomething = true;
294                        
295                        if (!event.isAlwaysShow()) {
296                                curr++;
297                        }
298                        if (curr >= num) break;
299                }
300                
301                //BaseMissionHub.clearCreatedMissionsList(null, market);
302                ip.resetExcludeFromGetPerson();
303                
304                if (needToSaveShown) {
305                        float time = BAR_EVENT_MIN_TIME_BEFORE_CHANGING + 
306                                                 (BAR_EVENT_MAX_TIME_BEFORE_CHANGING - BAR_EVENT_MIN_TIME_BEFORE_CHANGING) * random.nextFloat();
307                        mem.set(key, shown, time);
308                }
309                
310                if (returningFromEvent) {
311                        if (!addedSomething) {
312                                dialog.getTextPanel().addPara("Nothing of note is going on at the bar.");
313                        } else {
314                                dialog.getTextPanel().addPara("You unobtrusively watch the patrons of the bar for " +
315                                                                                          "a few minutes before deciding what to do next.");
316                        }
317                }
318                
319                dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption("Leave the bar", "barLeave");
320                dialog.getOptionPanel().setShortcut("barLeave", Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
321                
322                
323                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
324                        DevMenuOptions.addOptions(dialog);
325                }
326                
327                dialog.setPlugin(this);
328                init(dialog);
329        }

331        public void optionSelected(String optionText, Object optionData) {
332                if (optionText != null) {
333                        //dialog.getTextPanel().addParagraph(optionText, Global.getSettings().getColor("buttonText"));
334                        dialog.addOptionSelectedText(optionData);
335                }
336                if (optionData == DumpMemory.OPTION_ID) {
337                        new DumpMemory().execute(null, dialog, null, getMemoryMap());
338                        return;
339                } else if (DevMenuOptions.isDevOption(optionData)) {
340                        DevMenuOptions.execute(dialog, (String) optionData);
341                        return;
342                }
343                
344                // need to abort any HubMissionBarEventWrapper missions that are *not* the current selection
345                String optionId = null;
346                if (optionData instanceof String) {
347                        optionId = (String) optionData;
348                }
349                
350                abortMissions(optionId);
351                
352                if (optionData instanceof PortsideBarEvent) {
353                        PortsideBarEvent event = (PortsideBarEvent) optionData;
354                        BarEventDialogPlugin plugin = new BarEventDialogPlugin(this, this, event, memoryMap);
355                        dialog.setPlugin(plugin);
356                        plugin.init(dialog);
357                        return;
358                } else if ("barLeave".equals(optionData)) {
359                        leaveBar();
360                } else if ("barContinue".equals(optionData)) {
361                        showOptions(true);
362                } else if (optionData instanceof String) {
363                        // a HubMissionBarEventWrapper option
364//                      HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = getWrapperFor(optionId);
365//                      if (w != null && w.getMission() != null) {
366//                              mem.set("$currMission_ref", w.getMission(), 0f);
367//                      } else {
368//                              mem.unset("$currMission_ref");
369//                      }
370                        
371                        MemoryAPI eMem = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
372                        eMem.set("$BarCMD", this, 0f);
373                        
374                        HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = getWrapperFor(optionId);
375                        if (w != null && w.getMission() != null) {
376                                PersonAPI person = w.getMission().getPerson();
377                                if (person != null) {
378                                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(person);
379                                        ((RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl)originalPlugin).updateMemory();
380//                                      memoryMap.put(MemKeys.ENTITY, memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL));
381//                                      memoryMap.put(MemKeys.LOCAL, person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate());
382                                        dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(person, true);
383                                }
384                        }
385                        
386                        MemoryAPI mem = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
387                        dialog.setPlugin(originalPlugin);
388                        mem.set("$option", (String) optionData, 0f);
389                        
390                        FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "DialogOptionSelected");
391                }
392        }

394        public void returningFromEvent(PortsideBarEvent event) {
395                returningFromEvent(event.endWithContinue());
396        }
397        public void returningFromEvent(boolean withContinue) {
398                if (withContinue) {
399                        dialog.getOptionPanel().clearOptions();
400                        dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption("Continue", "barContinue");
401                } else {
402                        showOptions(true);
403                }
404        }
405        
406        public HubMissionBarEventWrapper getWrapperFor(String optionId) {
407                PortsideBarData data = PortsideBarData.getInstance();
408                for (PortsideBarEvent event : data.getEvents()) {
409                        if (event instanceof HubMissionBarEventWrapper) {
410                                HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = (HubMissionBarEventWrapper) event;
411                                if (w.getMission() == null) continue;
412                                if (optionId != null && optionId.startsWith(w.getMission().getTriggerPrefix())) {
413                                        return w;
414                                }
415                        }
416                }
417                return null;
418        }
419        public void abortMissions(String optionId) {
420                PortsideBarData data = PortsideBarData.getInstance();
421                for (PortsideBarEvent event : data.getEvents()) {
422                        if (event instanceof HubMissionBarEventWrapper) {
423                                HubMissionBarEventWrapper w = (HubMissionBarEventWrapper) event;
424                                if (w.getMission() == null) continue;
425                                if (optionId == null || !optionId.startsWith(w.getMission().getTriggerPrefix())) {
426                                        w.abortMission();
427                                }
428                        }
429                }
430        }

433        public static BarAmbiencePlayer getAmbiencePlayer() {
434                for (EveryFrameScript script : Global.getSector().getTransientScripts()) {
435                        if (script instanceof BarAmbiencePlayer) {
436                                return (BarAmbiencePlayer) script;
437                        }
438                }
439                return null;            
440        }

442        public void leaveBar() {
443                
444                BarAmbiencePlayer player = getAmbiencePlayer();
445                if (player != null) {
446                        player.stop();
447                }
448                
449                if (originalPlugin != null) {
450                        dialog.setPlugin(originalPlugin);
451                }
452                
453                new ShowDefaultVisual().execute(null, dialog, Misc.tokenize(""), memoryMap);
454                FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "ReturnFromBar");
455        }
